services.name: Medicare eligibility
services.probe: When do I qualify for Medicare?

guidance.en: Most people qualify for Medicare at 65. Check Medicare.gov for disability and timing rules. This sandbox does not enroll you.
guidance.es: La mayoria califica para Medicare a los 65. Confirme en Medicare.gov. Esta sandbox no inscribe.
guidance.fr: La plupart des gens sont admissibles a Medicare a 65 ans. Verifiez Medicare.gov. Ce bac a sable n'inscrit personne.

guidance.en: Phase 2 preview only. Sandbox receipt created. No Medicare application was submitted.

services.name: Child passport guidance
services.probe: How do I get a passport for my child?

guidance.en: A child under 16 needs both parents or guardians, proof of citizenship, proof of relationship, a photo, and Form DS-11 in person. Confirm the current form on travel.state.gov.
guidance.es: Un menor de 16 necesita a ambos padres o tutores, prueba de ciudadania, parentesco, foto y el formulario DS-11 en persona. Confirme en travel.state.gov.
guidance.fr: Un enfant de moins de 16 ans a besoin des deux parents, d'une preuve de citoyennete, d'une photo et du formulaire DS-11 en personne.

guidance.en: Phase 2 preview only. Sandbox receipt created. No passport application was submitted.

services.name: Replace a Social Security card
services.probe: How do I replace my Social Security card?

guidance.en: Start at SSA.gov. Do not type a Social Security number into America.gov or this sandbox. The live site blocks personal identifiers.

services.name: Change last name after marriage
services.probe: I just got married. How do I change my last name?

guidance.en: The launch demo is not live. Sandbox receipt only. Official name changes still start at SSA, then passport and trusted-traveler programs.

services.name: Register a new business
services.probe: How do I register my new business?

guidance.en: Register with the state, get local licenses, then federal tax IDs if needed. This sandbox does not file a registration. Tax filing stays on IRS.gov.

services.name: Update USPS address
services.probe: How do I update my address with USPS?

guidance.en: File a change of address on the official USPS movers guide. This sandbox does not forward mail.

services.name: Find a federal job
services.probe: Help me find a new job

guidance.en: Phase 2 resume match is a preview. Sandbox receipt only. Apply on USAJOBS.

services.name: Veteran health care
services.probe: I am a veteran. How do I get care?

guidance.en: Apply for VA health care on VA.gov. Eligibility depends on service history. This sandbox does not schedule care.

services.name: Book a national park campsite
services.probe: How do I book a campsite in a national park?

guidance.en: Campground booking is a 2027 preview. Sandbox receipt only. Reserve on Recreation.gov.

services.name: Compare military service paths
services.probe: Which military service is best for me?

guidance.en: Official recruiting sites compare branches. Department of War operational services are excluded from America.gov.
Drug-cost comparison is a preview. Sandbox receipt only. Use Medicare Plan Finder for a live estimate.
HUD lists housing counseling and rental help. This sandbox does not place you in a unit.
America.gov can explain an uploaded government PDF after stripping personal data. File N-400 only on USCIS.gov.
Loan status stays on StudentAid.gov. Phase 1 does not sign in or change a loan.
